verdict.summary_en: Chinese-language delivery note SN-261007-850 dated 2026/10/07 from Guangzhou PackRight Packaging to Soony DC Hamburg, against PO 4500318726. It lists one line, PR-RB-2207 Collector's Box Grand Heist 6, 21,800 PCS in 4 packages, 80 kg gross, carried by Nordhav Shipping A/S. A blue DC-HAM stamp shows it was received 11.11.2026. The supplier's red seal is applied. The receiver signature line is blank and there are no handwritten corrections.
red_flags: Receiver signature line (收货签字) is blank; only the DC-HAM received stamp is present.
The note shows no ordered quantity, so 21,800 PCS cannot be checked against the PO from this document alone.
Item description is cut off at '(rig', so the full product name is not visible.
Gross weight of 80 kg for 21,800 PCS in 4 packages looks low (about 3.7 g per piece), and the weight and quantity were not checked against each other by the supplier. Recorded as written.
observations: The red supplier seal overlaps the table header cells 单位 and 件数 and part of the 'PCS' cell, but the values are still readable.
Description text ends with '(rig' and appears truncated on the paper.
Blue rectangular stamp 'RECEIVED 11.11.2026 / DC-HAM' sits below the remarks area.
The remarks field and the receiver signature line are empty.
No handwriting, strike-throughs or overwrites seen.
